text:
[Council File 23-0600-S121]
Los Angeles Department of Transportation, Board of Police Commissioners, and City Attorney reports relative to an independent evaluation of the Vision Zero Program and pedestrian safety legislation.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council is receiving reports from LADOT, the Police Commission and the City Attorney on an independent review of the Vision Zero traffic safety program and pedestrian safety laws.

outcome.text: Transportation Committee action: Noted and Filed: Note & File the 9/24/26 LADOT and 6/3/26 Board of Police Commissioners reports (Nov 18, 2026)
